name: cage-admin
description: Dev tooling only (lint/format/emulator tests) - the app itself has no build step; index.html and the other pages deploy as-is via Firebase Hosting.

scripts.test:balance-emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project cage-admin-balance-emulator-test "node test/balance-emulator.test.js"
scripts.test:dual-write-compat: npx --yes firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project cage-admin-balance-compat-test "node test/dual-write-compat.test.js"
